969-2023-4518-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

529-5434-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4691-4971-5796.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4691-4971-5796.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
4691-4971-5796.description:
Draw a card.
When you draw a card, Niv-Mizzet and Starving Revenant's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Starving Revenant ability, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet ability, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
When you lose life, Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1349-6495-6863--133.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Dinosaur in your hand.
There is a coin counter on Blue.
1349-6495-6863--133.description:
Cast the Dinosaur in your hand by paying its mana cost. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, Athreos's second ability triggers, returning the Dinosaur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2.
1349-6495-6863--133.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2557-5478-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
2557-5478-6753-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

301-5961-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

1003-1778-1927-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-1778-1927-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

2645-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Doc Samson.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it. 
Repeat.

1806-2060-5147-5902-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1322-3259-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3705-4050-4668-5997.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
3705-4050-4668-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1946-3169-4659-7070.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Nomads en-Kor.
Cast Nomads en-Kor from exile by paying {2}.
When Nomads en-Kor enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2615-6562-6965.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-6562-6965.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2034-2279-4094-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2279-4094-5220-6961.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-1887-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vorinclex.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
1495-1887-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

763-4929-6824.description:
Activate Juju Bubble by paying {2}, causing you to gain 1 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

5670-6792-6794--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
5670-6792-6794--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

565-676-1858--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token.
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-676-1858--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

797-1329-3169-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control a number of artifacts equal to or greater than two plus Emry's commander tax.
You have enough mana to cast Stolen Identity
797-1329-3169-4050.description:
Cast Stolen Identity by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Genesis Chamber.
Cast Emry from the command zone by paying {U}.
When Emry enters the battlefield, it and both Genesis Chambers trigger.
Resolve the Emry trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
Resolve both Genesis Chamber triggers, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Choose to return Emry to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.

3391-4050-4871-5752.description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Brokkos.
When Brokkos dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 4 three additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U/B}{B}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Brokkos from your graveyard for its mutate ability by paying {2}{U/B}{G}{G}, putting it on top of a Saproling token.
Repeat.

851-4659-5365-5494.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
851-4659-5365-5494.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

57-2178-4050-5004.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
57-2178-4050-5004.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Cathodion with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Cathodion token, adding {R}.
When the Cathodion token dies, it and Feldon of the Third Path trigger.
Resolve the Feldon of the Third Path trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

628-914-2034-4153.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
Dockside Extortionist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-914-2034-4153.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving all +1/+1 counters from Dockside Extortionist onto another permanent you control.
Repeat.
If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1561-2498.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a library size that is at least half their life total.
1561-2498.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing an opponent to draw cards equal to half their library size and lose half their life total, rounded up.
Sheoldred's second ability triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve the first Sheoldred trigger, causing the opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat step 3 until the opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1727-3359-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Moorland Rescuer.
Moorland Rescuer dies, triggering itself and Hofri Ghostforge.
Resolve the Hofri Ghostforge trigger, exiling Moorland Rescuer from your graveyard and creating a token copy of Moorland Rescuer that has "When this creature leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to your graveyard".
Resolve the Moorland Rescuer trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Moorland Rescuer's power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Moorland Rescuer token.
The Moorland Rescuer token dies, triggering itself twice.
Resolve the Moorland Rescuer token's trigger granted by Hofri Ghostforge, returning Moorland Rescuer from exile to your graveyard.
Resolve the other Moorland Rescuer trigger, returning Moorland Rescuer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 6, causing target player to mill cards equal to Moorland Rescuer's power.
Repeat.

215-3809-4541.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Treasures.
215-3809-4541.description:
Activate four Treasures you control by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}.
Cast Marut by paying {8}.
Marut enters the battlefield, creating eight Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2882-4370-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-4370-4675-4694.description:
Cast Darksteel Relic by paying {0}.
Darksteel Relic enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Darksteel Relic from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
